notes.note: Roberts was back and he had the second best score for the Bombers with his 23 disposals. A good return and result for those that held.
Roberts suffered a dislocated shoulder and left the game in the second term. This will be yet another forced trade for many coaches as he looks like missing significant time.
The key to Roberts first score over 100 in the last four games was the efficiency with his 22 disposals going at 86%.
Roberts had the tag from Murdock this week as we thought may happen. He finished with 31 disposals with 10 being from kick ins. He did give away 4 free kicks which hurt him.

Roberts was quiet in the first term but did find the footy after that. His role was moved around a bit with the injuries the Dons had early in the game. He missed his BE but he will be a fine hold still.

Huge night for Archie with 42 disposals and 11 marks to top score in the game. This was his best of the season and he has shown how good he is in that half back role. He is one you can consider for a VC or C.
Roberts kept his streak alive but only just. 27 disposals at 77% as he was only one of just three Bombers to reach 100 in the heavy loss.

Roberts was fantastic yet again with his 42 disposals and 9 marks. He is a must have in defence. His price is rising sharply so time to get him or you will have to wait for one poor score to bring it down.
Roberts continues to deliver and he is fast becoming too expensive for us to bring in if we don't have him. 24 kicks 9 handballs and 7 marks. He is looking like a top 6 defender.
Roberts has been on fire of late after that poor first round. But the last two have been 130+. Will be a popular selection while the Bombers are playing this style of game.
We didn't see this one coming! Huge from Roberts with 29 kicks 8 handballs and 12 marks for his third over 100 in a row which has seen his BE land at 50.
This is another great outing from Roberts with his second 100+ score in a row. This is more what we expected when many people were picking him at the start of the season.

This is the sort of game we expected from Roberts when we picked him for round 1. 26 disposals and 11 contested possessions. His BE of 106 means he isn't going to make us some big cash. So we need big scores to keep him.

Roberts was popular across the preseason and ended in 9% of teams. He didn't reach the level that we were hoping from his 20 disposals at 65%. We have another week before his price changes so you can wait for one more.
Roberts has been a preseason hype player and one that you may want to look into for your starting squad.
